# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series, passing away several years later.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P5](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0005), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing man with an awkward, hunching frame and lengthy, iron-gray hair reaching to his shoulders. He wears a thick, gentle brown beard that he has kept continuously since the age of twenty. In his older years, his hair turns grayer, and he is often seen in work clothes, though he puts on a white collar and his finest suit for long journeys or formal visits.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

Obed is extraordinarily timid, bashful, and quiet, preferring to avoid unfamiliar people and women in particular, whom he fears might be quietly mocking him. He speaks very little and rarely offers details or opinions unless pressed, yet he possesses a deep, quiet stubbornness when he fixes his heart on something. He appreciates loquacious companions who handle conversation entirely on their own, and he shows immense gentleness, patience, and silent affection toward children.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

- Carpentry and handiwork  <sub>[v1 c10 P6](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0006), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure help for farm labor as he advances in age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- To provide a loving home for Nell Harcourt and keep her at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza. Seeking farm assistance in his sixties, he and Thirza send word to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia. When Obed travels to Alder River to meet the train, he discovers that an orphan girl, Nell Harcourt, has been brought by mistake. Though terrified of unfamiliar females, Obed enjoys Nell's lively chatter on the buggy ride home. Upon learning that Thirza intends to send her back, Obed quietly insists on keeping her, and Thirza ultimately relents.

Obed grows deeply attached to Nell, continuously indulging her with gifts such as sweeties and a new dress with fashionable puffed sleeves, while secretly interceding to save her from harsh punishments. Over the following years, he works hard on the farm despite failing health and heart trouble. During a severe winter, he travels in the dead of night to secure a physician for a croup-afflicted child, proving instrumental in saving her life. When Nell wins the prestigious Avery scholarship, Obed is filled with immense pride. Shortly thereafter, he receives a letter announcing the sudden failure of the Abbey Bank, where his life savings are held; the shock triggers a fatal heart attack, and he passes away peacefully with a smile upon his face.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c18 P32](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0032), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P34](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0034), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Son of a bashful father who built Grey Shutters on the outermost border of his cleared property  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Resided at Grey Shutters with his sister Thirza since reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Suffered from long-standing heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028)</sub>
- Loyal voter for the Conservative political party  <sub>[v1 c18 P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009), [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>
